description: Find the currently active sprint and its tasks. Optionally scoped by space_id or space_name; scans all spaces if omitted.

include_timl.description: Include tasks added via 'Tasks in Multiple Lists'. Defaults to true for sprints.

team_id.description: The ClickUp Team ID or Workspace Name to use. If provided, the server will switch to this workspace for this and subsequent requests in the current session.

name: get_active_sprint
